title: feat(spec): export isListComparandOperator from @objectstack/spec/data; flow record nodes read it instead of a local copy
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ83ALm8EpEcYUomnqmETUEW1)_

Fixes #29419

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/spec/data` 新增导出谓词 `isListComparandOperator(op)`，对声明列表比较值的字段运算符（`$in` / `$nin` / `$between`）答 true，其余答 false；流程记录节点（`crud-nodes.ts`）改为导入它，删掉本地那份 `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` 副本及其对账测试。
- 为什么改：#29404 的合约评审 should-fix 2：执行器持有一份运算符拆分的副本，靠一条行为对账测试保持一致；现在只有 spec 一处来源，对账断言随谓词搬进 `packages/spec`。
- 风险与回滚：纯新增导出（加宽），执行器的接受与拒绝行为不变；两份集合本身仍不导出。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.ts`（谓词与改写的模块说明），`packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.test.ts`（对账断言的新家），`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts`（导入替换）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/filter-comparand-operators.test.ts`，预期 1 个测试文件、2 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`isListComparandOperator(op: string): boolean`** (`packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.ts`), exported from `@objectstack/spec/data` (`packages/spec/src/data/index.ts`, a named re-export). It answers whether a `$`-spelled field operator declares a LIST comparand, reading the same `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` set the comparand-type face reads. TSDoc is one sentence.
- **Why a predicate and not the set.** The card allows either. A published `ReadonlySet` is still a live `Set` at run time: a caller that cast and mutated it would change what every comparand face in `packages/spec` judges. The predicate publishes the answer and keeps both sets module-private. The module docblock's section "Why it is NOT in the `data` barrel" is rewritten to say what the barrel now publishes from the file and why the sets stay out.
- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts`**: `operandValueRefusal` asks `isListComparandOperator(last)`; the local `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` and its docblock are removed, and the function docblock names the spec predicate. An import swap, nothing else.
- **Retired test**: `crud-filter-guard.test.ts` "every declared operator whose comparand is a list takes an evaluated list, and no other does", plus its now-unused `FieldOperatorsSchema` import. Its assertion, every operator `FieldOperatorsSchema` declares is a list operator exactly when its enforced slot takes a list, now lives in `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.test.ts`, against the predicate the executor calls. That is the same assertion at a layer closer to the code. The executor's own use of the predicate stays pinned by the file's remaining list-operator cases (see the ablation below).
- **Generated**: `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json` and `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json` gain the one row each.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/29419-list-comparand-operator-predicate.md`, `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/service-automation`, carrying both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-operators.test.ts` (2 cases), importing through the `data` barrel: the predicate answers `true` exactly for each declared operator whose `FieldOperatorsSchema` slot accepts a two-item list (with a control that the grammar declares more than ten operators, and the derived list pinned to `$between`, `$in`, `$nin`), and `false` for undeclared spellings (`in`, `between`, `$and`, `$or`, `$not`, `$IN`, the empty string, `has`).
- `crud-filter-guard.test.ts` loses the one retired case: 66 to 65.
- **Forced test edits:** none beyond the retirement above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset level.** The claim assumed a spec minor. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 ties the level to `Metadata-protocol` alone, and `none` takes `patch`, so both packages ship `patch`.
- **File surface addition.** The new spec test file is outside the claim's listed surface. It is where the retired reconciliation lands, so I added it here.
- **Other local copies, not touched.** `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` and `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/rls-check-stored-form.ts` each hold their own `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` (`$in`, `$nin`, `$between`). Both equal the spec set today, and neither is in this card's scope. Not filed: there is no defect, only a possible follow-up to read the new predicate.
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts` keeps its own module-private `LIST_COMPARAND_OPERATORS` map (operator to authoring spellings). It is a different shape, unchanged.
- No `protocol.ts` file is touched.
